review_candidates.title: Branded Content Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Content House, a market leader behind some of Malta’s leading media brands - including WhosWho.mt , MaltaCEOs.mt , Gwida.mt and GuideMeMalta.com - is looking for a Branded Content Coordinator to coordinate the delivery of sponsored and branded content across our portfolio. Working primarily across online platforms, video and podcasts, you’ll coordinate projects for clients across a range of sectors, manage assignments and production schedules, and act as the main client contact from brief to publication. On any given day, you could be coordinating a shoot at a two-Michelin-star restaurant, scheduling an interview with the CEO of Malta’s largest bank, or organising a social media reel for the launch of a new five-star hotel. Your role is to bring it all together: gather client briefs, assign work, organise logistics, manage schedules and keep clients and colleagues informed. Our dedicated writing, filming, editing and design teams handle content creation and technical production. You won’t be expected to write articles, film, edit videos or design content yourself. This is a hands-on coordination role for someone who combines excellent organisational skills with an understanding of content, enjoys working with people and takes pride in delivering quality work. The role Your responsibilities will include: Conducting meetings with clients to gather project briefs and requirements, and ensuring deliverables and deadlines are clear. Coordinating sponsored articles, branded videos, podcasts and social media content across our leading media brands. Assigning and briefing our dedicated content and production teams, ensuring everyone knows what is required and when. Organising client video shoots and podcast recordings, including schedules, locations, participants and production arrangements. Liaising with clients throughout production, keeping them informed and managing feedback and approvals. Overseeing content calendars and tracking projects through to publication. Checking that deliverables meet the agreed brief and that client feedback reaches the relevant team. Working closely with our commercial and creative teams to ensure projects run smoothly and are delivered on time. About you You’re highly organised, proactive and comfortable working under pressure and managing several projects at once. You can turn a client brief into clear assignments, keep work moving and build positive relationships with clients and colleagues. We’re looking for: Relevant experience in project coordination, client services, media, marketing, advertising or content production. Excellent communication and client relationship skills. Fluency in both Maltese and English would be considered an asset. Exceptional organisational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines. Strong attention to detail and reliable follow-through. An understanding of online publishing, social media, video and podcasts. The confidence to coordinate dedicated teams, resolve scheduling challenges and take ownership of delivery. The ability to proofread and edit written content would be an asset. Technical production skills are not required. What matters is your ability to organise people and projects, communicate clearly and keep every stage on track. Join Content House This is an opportunity to work across some of Malta’s leading online media brands, collaborate with a talented team and help coordinate the commercial content we produce for an extensive and diverse range of clients. This is a fully on-site role, based at our modern offices at The Quad Central, in the Central Business District. For more information on Content House, visit contenthouse.mt. To apply, send your CV and a short introduction to careers@contenthouse.mt.

With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. Bilingual Operations Manager Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day—building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with limitless entrepreneurial spirit, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. As we continue to scale our global platform, the Bilingual Operations Manager will play a critical role in leading screenprint manufacturing operations and driving high-performance teams across facility departments. ROLE OVERVIEW The Bilingual Operations Manager is responsible for leading a screenprint manufacturing facility, directly overseeing supervisors and 100+ athletes across departments while partnering cross-functionally to drive operational excellence. This role serves as an advocate for both athletes and fans, leveraging bilingual communication to foster an inclusive, high-performing culture through active mentorship and constructive feedback. The Bilingual Operations Manager delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams) Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with cross-functional teams — including planning, quality, and fulfillment — to align manufacturing operations with broader facility and business goals. Serve as a bilingual bridge between leadership and frontline athletes, ensuring clear, consistent communication flows across all levels of the organization. People Leadership: Provide direct leadership and development to supervisors, holding them accountable to performance standards while coaching them to grow as leaders. Lead, mentor, and engage 100+ athletes across facility departments, fostering a culture of accountability, belonging, and continuous improvement. Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans) Champion the fan experience by ensuring screenprint manufacturing operations consistently deliver high-quality, on-time product that meets the expectations of fans worldwide. Serve as an advocate for fans throughout the production process, making decisions that prioritize product integrity and brand standards. Identify and act on opportunities to improve throughput and quality, directly supporting the ability to fulfill fan demand at scale. Build a team culture that connects frontline athletes to the fan impact of their work, driving pride and purpose across the facility. Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit) Identify operational inefficiencies within the screenprint facility and champion data-driven solutions that improve throughput, quality, and cost. Encourage a culture of continuous improvement by empowering supervisors and athletes to surface ideas and experiment with better ways of working. Apply emerging tools, technologies, and automation opportunities to modernize facility operations and reduce manual dependency. Approach complex manufacturing and people challenges with creative problem-solving, adapting quickly when conditions change. Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset) Own facility KPIs end-to-end — including productivity, quality, safety, and attendance — and drive accountability at every level of the operation. Report directly to the Senior Operations Manager or General Manager, providing clear and transparent updates on performance, risks, and opportunities. Execute operational plans with urgency and precision, ensuring department commitments are met even in high-volume or high-pressure environments. Model a relentless standard of excellence, holding yourself and your teams to the highest expectations while maintaining a respectful, people-first environment. AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING Required Qualifications: Bilingual proficiency (English and Spanish) required, with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with diverse teams in both languages. Proven experience leading manufacturing or distribution operations, including direct management of large frontline workforces (100+ employees preferred). Track record of developing and holding accountable a team of supervisors in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment. Strong understanding of screenprint or apparel manufacturing processes, quality standards, and production planning is highly preferred. Demonstrated ability to drive performance through mentorship, constructive feedback, and active floor presence — not just from behind a desk. Experience partnering cross-functionally with departments such as planning, quality assurance, human resources, and supply chain to deliver operational results. Ability to use data and operational metrics to identify trends, address gaps, and make informed decisions that improve facility performance. WORK LOCATION On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Fairdale, KY. At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team. About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. About The Team Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com. Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA). At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do: Build Championship Teams Obsessed with Fans Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit Determined and Relentless Mindset By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

review_candidates.title: Automation Engineer Systemintegration & Inbetriebnahme
review_candidates.description: Wenn aus Technik ein funktionierendes Gesamtsystem wird. Die Matti Technology AG in Sulgen entwickelt und baut industrielle Digitaldruckmaschinen für internationale Kunden. Ihre Anlagen verbinden anspruchsvolle Mechanik mit moderner Steuerungs- und Antriebstechnik, Sensorik, SPS und Software. Für die Weiterentwicklung und Inbetriebnahme dieser Systeme suchen wir eine erfahrene technische Persönlichkeit, die Zusammenhänge erkennt, Schnittstellen beherrscht und Anlagen mit systematischem Vorgehen zuverlässig zum Laufen bringt. Automation Engineer Systemintegration & Inbetriebnahme Sie begleiten neue Maschinen und Module von der technischen Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen erarbeiten Sie Systemlösungen und legen Elektro-, Antriebs- und Sensortechnik aus. Einen besonderen Schwerpunkt bildet die Integration der verschiedenen Disziplinen zu einem funktionierenden Gesamtsystem. Dabei entwickeln und realisieren Sie Automations- und Steuerungslösungen im Umfeld von SPS/PLC, Motion und Maschinensteuerung. Sie planen und führen Funktionstests durch, analysieren Störungen methodisch und optimieren Systeme so lange, bis ein stabiler produktiver Betrieb erreicht ist. Bei internationalen Kunden begleiten Sie die Inbetriebnahme vor Ort und sorgen für eine professionelle Übergabe der Anlagen in die Produktion. Erkenntnisse aus Tests und Feldbetrieb dokumentieren Sie strukturiert und bringen diese direkt in die Weiterentwicklung zukünftiger Maschinengenerationen ein. Ihr Profil Sie verfügen über einen Abschluss HF oder FH in Elektrotechnik, Automation, Mechatronik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung im Maschinen-, Sondermaschinen- oder Anlagenbau mit. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt idealerweise in der Automation, Systemintegration oder Inbetriebnahme komplexer technischer Systeme. Elektrokonzepte, SPS-Steuerungen sowie Antriebs- und Sensortechnik sind Ihnen vertraut. Erfahrung mit CODESYS, Beckhoff TwinCAT und CAE beziehungsweise E-Plan ist besonders willkommen. Entscheidend ist Ihre Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge über Fachgrenzen hinweg zu verstehen, Fehler systematisch einzugrenzen und auch bei anspruchsvollen Inbetriebnahmen Verantwortung bis zur Lösung zu übernehmen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gutes Englisch und eine weltweite Reisebereitschaft von rund 10 Prozent ergänzen Ihr Profil. Was Ihnen geboten wird Sie erwartet eine vielseitige Systemtechnik-Funktion mit direktem Bezug zur realen Maschine. Von der Konzeption über Software und Integration bis zur Inbetriebnahme begleiten Sie den gesamten technischen Entstehungsprozess und sehen unmittelbar, wie aus Engineering ein funktionierendes Produktionssystem wird. Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein erfahrenes interdisziplinäres Team sowie Engineering, Montage und Prüffeld am Standort Sulgen bieten dafür ein technisch attraktives Umfeld. Für konzentrierte Entwicklungsarbeiten ist punktuell auch Homeoffice möglich.

As a Senior Observability / DevOps Engineer, you’ll drive the migration of monitoring, logging, integrations, security configurations, and automation while leveraging Datadog, Terraform, AWS, and Kubernetes to build a scalable and resilient observability platform. Validate migrated monitoring, observability, and security configurations before cutover. Support AWS and Kubernetes/EKS integrations. Qualifications 7+ years of experience in Observability, DevOps, or Platform Engineering. 5+ years of hands-on Datadog implementation, administration, and migration experience. Proven experience with Datadog organization and account migrations, including parent/child and multi-organization environments. Strong experience with Datadog API, CLI, and Terraform Datadog Provider. Hands-on experience with Datadog monitors, dashboards, SLOs, Agents, APM, and distributed tracing. Experience with Datadog Log Management, including pipelines, indexes, archives, and retention configurations. Experience integrating Datadog with AWS, Kubernetes, and AWS EKS. Experience with RBAC, SAML/SSO, SCIM, and API/Application key management, including rotation and access controls. Experience with CI/CD and automation integrations. Nice to Have Datadog Certified Professional. Datadog Partner or consulting background. Enterprise observability architecture experience. Experience validating monitoring parity in dual-running environments before cutover. Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities. Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events. Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality. Marketing Communications • Develop institutional and marketing content for campaigns, programs, initiatives, events, partnership and sponsorship activities, brochures, websites, email communications, promotional materials, and selected digital channels. • Translate complex institutional information into clear, persuasive, and audience focused communication. • Adapt content and messaging for different stakeholders, channels, and communication objectives while maintaining consistency in tone of voice and institutional positioning. Knowledge Management • Develop and maintain proposal and sponsorship package templates, presentation templates, messaging frameworks, content guidelines, and institutional communication assets. • Maintain content repositories, approved institutional facts, key messages, value propositions, narratives, and reusable content resources. Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Marketing Communications, Corporate Communications, Public Relations, or a closely related field is mandatory. • Professional certifications in Proposal Writing, Corporate Communications, Marketing Communications, Branding, Partnership Management, Business Development, Content Strategy, or related disciplines are preferred. Experience • Minimum of 7 years of progressive professional experience in Institutional Communications, Corporate Communications, Marketing Communications, Proposal Development, Partnership Communications, Sponsorships, or Resource Mobilization. • Proven experience developing partnership proposals, sponsorship packages, value propositions, executive presentations, institutional profiles, and business development materials is mandatory. • Proven experience supporting partnerships, sponsorships, fundraising, resource mobilization, or business development through institutional content is mandatory. • Proven experience writing customized proposals for corporate partners, institutional stakeholders, sponsors, or funding organizations is mandatory. • Proven experience developing institutional and marketing content for programs, initiatives, events, campaigns, and stakeholder engagement is required. • Experience developing executive presentations, pitch decks, institutional narratives, scripts, creative briefs, storyboards, and institutional or marketing video content is highly preferred. • Experience working with creative designers, multimedia producers, photographers, agencies, and other production specialists is highly preferred. • Experience developing content for conferences, forums, international events, financial institutions, consulting firms, non profit organizations, government entities, or international organizations is highly preferred. • Demonstrated experience writing and editing executive level content in both Arabic and English is required. Skills and Competencies • Exceptional Arabic and English writing, editing, proofreading, proposal writing, and institutional business writing skills. • Strong storytelling, messaging, narrative, value proposition, copywriting, scriptwriting, and creative briefing skills. • Ability to develop compelling proposals, sponsorship packages, executive presentations, institutional marketing materials, and campaign content. • Strong understanding of corporate and marketing communications, branding, stakeholder engagement, partnerships, sponsorships, and resource mobilization. • Strong research, analytical, conceptual, and strategic thinking skills. • Ability to translate complex information into clear, persuasive, executive level communication for different audiences and formats. • Ability to develop content and messaging that can be effectively translated into visual, audiovisual, digital, and campaign materials. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with AI powered content development tools. Experience with relevant creative tools is considered an advantage. • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams while maintaining ownership of institutional content, messaging, proposals, and narratives. • Full professional proficiency in Arabic and English, written and spoken, is mandatory. Other Requirements • Availability to travel as required based on business needs. • Undertake other institutional content, marketing communications, partnership communications, executive communications, and related content assignments as directed by the Manager of Communications & Media Department where such assignments support departmental or organizational objectives. Collaboration and Reporting • The role reports directly to the Manager of Communications & Media Department and collaborates with other team members as a peer within its area of expertise. • No peer role holds line management authority over another unless formally assigned by the Manager of Communications & Media Department. • Work priorities, communication direction, key messages, and final deliverables are determined and approved by the Manager of Communications & Media Department . • Collaborate across partnerships and relations, creative design, and multimedia production to ensure a consistent and compelling institutional story across communication outputs. Personal Attributes • Creative with strong institutional and business awareness. • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality. • Professional presence and strong executive communication skills. • Strong ownership, accountability, initiative, and judgment. • Ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines. • Collaborative and effective in multidisciplinary and stakeholder environments. Application Requirement Applicants are required to submit a portfolio demonstrating previous work in partnership proposals, sponsorship packages, executive presentations, institutional profiles, video scripts, creative briefs, presentation narratives, or similar institutional communication projects. Recruitment Process The recruitment process will consist of multiple stages: Stage 1 Shortlisted candidates will be invited to: ·      Participate in an initial online interview. ·      Complete a written assessment. Stage 2 Candidates who successfully pass the first stage will be invited to: ·      Attend a final in-person interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted throughout the recruitment process. 📩 To apply, please send your CV along with any relevant writing samples, portfolio, or previous work to: hiring@albaraka.org

review_candidates.description: Job Summary: The Learning & Development Specialist is responsible for supporting and coordinating the organization’s learning and development activities across Egypt. The role ensures that employees have access to relevant learning opportunities, training programs are effectively planned and delivered, and all learning activities are properly documented and tracked. Key Responsibilities: Support the development and implementation of the annual Learning & Development plan based on business requirements and identified employee development needs. Collect training and development requirements from department heads and managers. Consolidate departmental training needs and maintain the annual training plan. Assist in prioritizing training requirements based on business needs, employee performance, compliance requirements, and available budgets. Monitor the implementation of the approved L&D plan throughout the year. Coordinate the Training Needs Analysis (TNA) process across different departments. Communicate with managers to identify employees’ technical, behavioral, managerial, and functional development needs. Analyze identified training gaps and recommend suitable learning solutions. Maintain an updated training needs database for employees and departments. Support the identification of critical skills and development requirements for key positions. Coordinate internal and external training programs, workshops, seminars, and development activities. Communicate with training providers and external consultants to obtain quotations, proposals, schedules, and course details. Coordinate training logistics including invitations, attendance, venues, virtual meeting links, materials, and required equipment. Ensure employees receive the required training information and joining instructions on time. Follow up with employees and managers regarding training attendance and completion. Coordinate onboarding and induction training in cooperation with HR and relevant departments. Support the organization of technical, soft-skills, leadership, compliance, and professional development programs. Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee training records. Track mandatory and recommended training for each employee. Maintain training attendance sheets, certificates, evaluations, and completion records. Ensure all training documents are properly filed and easily retrievable. Update the HR/L&D database and trackers on a regular basis. Monitor employee training hours and completion rates. Prepare monthly and quarterly L&D reports. Prepare and distribute training evaluation forms. Collect and analyze participant feedback. Monitor training effectiveness and identify areas for improvement. Follow up with managers regarding the application of acquired skills in the workplace. Support post-training assessments where applicable. Prepare training effectiveness reports and recommendations. Support the implementation of employee development plans. Coordinate development activities for employees based on identified skill gaps and career development requirements. Support career development and learning initiatives for high-potential employees. Assist managers in identifying suitable learning paths for their teams. Maintain individual development records where applicable. Coordinate employee participation in professional certifications, external courses, conferences, and specialized training programs. Track certification status, expiry dates, and renewal requirements where applicable. Maintain records of professional qualifications and completed certifications. Coordinate with employees and managers regarding certification and development requirements. Ensure L&D processes and records comply with company policies and applicable ISO requirements. Maintain all required training documentation for internal and external audits. Prepare L&D records and supporting documents required for ISO audits. Ensure mandatory training requirements are properly documented and monitored. Support HR in closing training-related audit findings and implementing corrective actions. Ensure training records are maintained in accordance with document-control requirements. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Education, or a related field. Professional certification in Learning & Development, HR, or Training is an advantage. 2–4 years of experience in Learning & Development, Training, HR, or a related role. Experience in coordinating training programs and maintaining employee development records. Experience working with HR systems and Excel/Google Sheets. Knowledge of training needs analysis and training evaluation methodologies. Experience with ISO documentation and audit requirements is an advantage. Required Skills Strong coordination and organizational skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Good presentation and facilitation skills. Strong follow-up and stakeholder management skills. Good analytical and reporting skills. Strong attention to detail and documentation. Ability to manage multiple training activities simultaneously. Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to work with HRIS/LMS systems. Good English communication skills. Ability to work independently and meet deadlines. Preferred Experience Experience in a corporate or technology/services environment. Experience supporting employees across multiple locations or countries. Experience with KSA and Egypt HR operations is an advantage. Experience supporting ISO audits and maintaining HR documentation. Experience working with external training providers and professional certification bodies.

review_candidates.title: Laboratory Material Testing Equipment Maintenance Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description : We are seeking a talented, dedicated, and detail-oriented Maintenance Engineer to oversee the upkeep, repair and calibration of our specialized laboratory equipment. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal performance of machines used in testing concrete, soil, cement and asphalt materials. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems with the ability to clearly communicate machine operations and settings to customers. Responsibilities · Conduct maintenance procedures for concrete, soil and asphalt labs equipment. · Troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems for different machines. · Utilize performance monitoring techniques to identify potential issues and optimize equipment performance. · Collaborate with the team to install different machines lab and implement maintenance strategies for lab construction materials testing machines. · Maintain accurate maintenance and calibrations for concrete, soil and asphalt material testing laboratory equipment.   Job Requirements We are looking for a talented and dedicated Maintenance Engineer to join our team ! If you possess the following qualifications, we encourage you to apply: ·        Experience : 1-3 years of experience in a maintenance engineering role. ·        Problem-Solving : Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. ·        Technical Skills : Solid understanding of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. ·        Has ability to explain how machine work to customer and how can adjust different setting for laboratory material testing equipment. ·        Teamwork : Excellent teamwork and communication skills. ·        Coordination : Ability to coordinate with other departments and teams.

review_candidates.title: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Unipro for Contracting & Trading Co. specializes in the design, supply, installation, and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) works. The company delivers integrated solutions for building and infrastructure projects, supporting safe and reliable operation of critical systems. Unipro focuses on quality, technical expertise, and timely project delivery. Team members work in a collaborative environment with exposure to diverse projects and modern engineering practices. Role Description The Electrical Maintenance Engineer will oversee the inspection, troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of electrical systems and equipment in MEP projects. Responsibilities include planning and executing preventive maintenance schedules, diagnosing electrical faults, coordinating with other engineering disciplines, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards. The role involves preparing maintenance reports, recommending improvements to system reliability, and supporting installation and commissioning activities. This is a full-time, on-site role located in Alexandria, requiring regular presence at project sites and facilities. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Electrical Engineering and Electricity, with a solid understanding of power distribution, control systems, and safety standards. Candidates should possess skills in Electrical Maintenance and Preventive Maintenance, including fault diagnosis, repair practices, and routine equipment inspections. Candidates should possess skills in Maintenance Engineering, including planning maintenance activities, optimizing downtime, and improving equipment reliability. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field. Experience in building services, industrial facilities, or MEP environments is preferred. Knowledge of electrical codes, safety regulations, and practical use of testing and diagnostic tools. Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and technical documentation. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work collaboratively on-site in Alexandria.
